remoteGroup.title: BTS Official Proof Compact Edition Photocard Kpop
remoteGroup.description:
COMBINED SHIPPING SPECIAL!
Free shipping on each additional photocard. Add to cart and save!

BTS Official Proof Compact Edition Photocard Kpop

This is an official photocard of a member from a globally recognized K-pop boy group, produced in South Korea.
Highly collectible and in strong demand among fans worldwide.
Each photocard features a unique design and is released in limited quantities, increasing its value over time.
A must-have item for serious collectors and dedicated fans.

Don't miss the chance to add this rare piece to your collection.

Please Read Before Purchasing

Official K-POP photocard produced in South Korea.
A special collectible loved by fans all over the world.

A small but meaningful piece of your favorite artist.
Perfect for collecting, gifting, or keeping as a memorable item.

Condition:
Minor scratches or small marks may occur due to manufacturing and packaging.
These are common characteristics and not considered defects.
All items are carefully inspected before shipping.

Shipping:
Ships from South Korea within 1-3 business days.
Delivery time may vary depending on location and customs.

Packaging:
Each photocard is safely packed with a protective sleeve and top loader
to ensure it arrives in good condition.

Returns:
All sales are final.
No cancellations or refunds unless the item is damaged during shipping.

Notice:
Import duties and taxes are the buyer's responsibility.
Please double-check your shipping information before purchase.

Thank you for supporting and loving K-POP
